name: freevectoricons
description: Connect Cursor and Grok agents to a FreeVectorIcons design collection — context, assets, downloads, and optional uploads via @freevectoricons/mcp.

FVI_TOKEN.title: Collection token
FVI_TOKEN.description: Collection-scoped bearer token from FreeVectorIcons → Collections → Integrations → Setup MCP. The collection is derived from this token. Never commit this value.

FVI_API_URL.title: API base URL
FVI_API_URL.description: API origin including /api. Leave default for production.

FVI_READ_ONLY.title: Read only
FVI_READ_ONLY.description: Set true to hide write tools (park/upload/version).
